'''Nogget''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calarmi]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] and [[Scout/Legends|scout]].

He was skilled in weaponry, and carried a field kit. He also had a modified [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nogget is described in the ''[[State of the Arts|Star Wars Galaxies Update]]'' article in [[Star Wars Gamer 3|''Star Wars Gamer'' 3]]. He is concept art for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.
